text:
maria: seeing apiserver 503s in eu-west1, spikes started ~10:42UTC, controller-manager restart noise
jonathan: same, alert: apiserver_request_5xx_rate > 0.3 over 1m
maria: digging: etcd WAL fsync latency spiking, iowait on controlplane nodes
avi: are GPU attach jobs correlated? provisioner queue shows backlog
avi: (typo) avi: are GPU attach jobs correlated? provisioner queue shows backlog
leila: yes, provisioning queue jumped 0 -> 120 around the time the WAL spikes started
maria: logs show repeated `etcdserver: WAL fsync took 3.2s` entries
jonathan: nvme iops look saturated on controlplane nics, p95 iowait ~3s
infra-bot: [metric snapshot] etcd_wal_fsync_ms p95=3200, apiserver_5xx=7.6%, controller_restart_count=4
avi: (again) avi: also seeing BGP peer churn on eu-west1-peering, RTT spikes 200-400ms
leila: could be noisy neighbor or NIC driver interrupt storms; remember i40e issues last quarter
maria: short mitigation suggestions: pause compactions, throttle provisioner, rotate apiserver replicas one-by-one
jonathan: leader transfer while WAL fsync is slow may hang, prefer throttling writes first
avi: avi: propose reducing provisioner concurrency to cut down etcd writes: set max_concurrent=10
leila: +1. Also add temporary alternate egress route to bypass flaky peering link
maria: applying provisioner throttle now: `kubectl patch configmap provisioner -p '{"data":{"max_concurrent":"10"}}'`
maria: kicking canary apiserver rotation now (one-by-one)
jonathan: watching metrics: apiserver_5xx trending down
deploy-bot: canary apiserver rotated at 10:55UTC
leila: after throttle queued gpu jobs dropped 120 -> 20
avi: avi: etcd WAL fsync p95 dropping to ~220ms after change
maria: rolling update complete, controller-manager restarts stopped
leila: follow-up: need postmortem on NVMe firmware behaviour + BGP peering stability; add runbook step to throttle provisioner during controlplane heavy IO
maria: opening incident ticket INC-2023-459
jonathan: add cost impact note: throttling increased provisioning latency for some customers, cc: finance
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
leila: follow-up action: schedule NVMe firmware validation in eu-west1 maintenance window
maria: will draft postmortem and runbook edits later today
sre-bot: reminder: set incident severity and notify oncall
